messages:
mara: opened a tiny PR to tighten wording around evidence exports and add two CLI snippets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/947
eli: thanks — can we show both a privacy-safe export and a legal/forensics one? customers get confused about stable IDs.
mara: sure — added samples. using --anonymize for privacy-safe, and a gated flag --preserve-uuids for forensic exports (requires legal ok).
eli: prefer the flag name --reveal-identifiers instead of --preserve-uuids? more explicit about intent.
mara: updated to --reveal-identifiers and added this note: "Use --reveal-identifiers only with an authorized legal request; this will expose stable identifiers and is logged for compliance."
compliance-bot: reminder: any doc that instructs how to surface stable identifiers must be reviewed by @compliance and @legal. Tag them on the PR.
mara: tagged. also added a short TTL note: exports respect tenant retention settings; older data will be omitted unless a legal_hold is in effect.
eli: small wording nit: say "are omitted" instead of "will be omitted" to avoid future-tense ambiguity.
mara: fixed. pushed.
link-bot: external links OK. internal playbook link flagged internal-only :warning: (leave as internal note).
eli: ran the snippets locally, both work. LGTM pending compliance sign-off.
mara: will wait for sign-off then merge and add a changelog line.
